articles.summary: Cority and Protex AI have teamed up to provide AI-driven, real-time safety monitoring, using CCTV to detect workplace hazards and prevent incidents before they happen in high-risk industries.
articles.title: Cority and Protex AI Partner to Bring Real-Time AI-Driven Safety Insights to High-Risk Industries

articles.summary: Protex AI, a leader in AI-driven workplace safety solutions, has been recognized as a Cool Vendor in the 2024 Gartner Cool Vendors in Logistics and Robotics Technology research.
articles.title: Protex AI Named a Cool Vendor in the 2024 Gartner® Cool Vendors™ in Logistics and Robotics Technology Research
